title: A Locker for the Mixtape
author: H. M. Hartwell
blurb: Jonah Hartwell, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the final audition.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
